title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Power BI reports as references in Copilot Notebooks
description: Copilot Notebooks now lets users add Power BI reports as references, bringing report data directly into their notebooks alongside files. Copilot uses this information to help generate more relevant summaries, presentations, and briefs grounded in the organization's data.
